welcome:
Absorbent turns a lecture recording into structured, illustrated notes. Send one audio/video recording or a link to it; add PDFs, presentations and photos separately, including by link. Supported: YouTube, public Yandex Disk and Google Drive files, direct HTTP(S) file links without authentication. You receive PDF, HTML, Markdown and ZIP.

Important: the bot can download Telegram attachments only up to 20 MB. This is a limit of the current Telegram Bot API, not Absorbent. We apologize for the inconvenience. For files larger than 20 MB, send a public Yandex Disk or Google Drive file link, or a direct file link: the file will be downloaded outside Telegram.

Processing limits: recording up to {max_hours} h and {max_media_gb} GB, materials up to {max_material_mb} MB and {max_pages} pages. Quota: {quota_jobs} runs per {quota_hours} h; administrators bypass the quota only.

Inputs and results remain on the server until an administrator deletes them. Data is sent to your selected cloud models; local models process it on this server. You review parameters and providers before starting.

Free and open-source software (FOSS), GNU GPL v3 or later. Self-host with your own local or cloud models:
https://github.com/ivan-mikhnovich/absorbent
https://github.com/ivan-mikhnovich/absorbobot

Installed core: Absorbent {version}
Commit: {commit}
help:
/new — new lecture: send a recording or a link to it, then additional materials and press “Files added”. Choose parameters and confirm the summary.
/jobs — history and redelivery; /settings — parameters; /language — language; /cancel — confirm cancellation of your unfinished jobs; /stats — your statistics; /version — versions.

The bot can download Telegram attachments only up to 20 MB. This is a limit of the current Telegram Bot API, not Absorbent. We apologize for the inconvenience. Upload larger files to the cloud (Yandex Disk or Google Drive) or your own server, enable access without authentication, and send a public file link or a direct HTTP(S) download link. Folders and private files are not supported. YouTube: one public video, not a livestream or playlist.

A task may combine sources: for example, a Yandex Disk video and a PDF slide attachment in Telegram. The 20 MB limit also applies to material attachments; a rejection does not remove previously accepted task files.

Photos use the largest available size; send as a document to preserve the original. Recordings are never silently concatenated. Deleting a Telegram message does not delete server files. Cancellation does not refund quota or money already spent. Free delivery of an existing result remains available when your quota is exhausted.
dialog.existing_draft: You already have a lecture draft. Replace it with a new lecture? Existing files remain on the server. Active preparation must stop first.
dialog.stopping_draft: Stopping preparation. Once it has stopped, use /new to create a fresh lecture.
dialog.send_source: New lecture. Send exactly one recording up to 20 MB through Telegram, or a public recording link (Yandex Disk, Google Drive, direct HTTP(S), YouTube). Then add materials. The 20 MB attachment download limit is imposed by Telegram Bot API; we apologize for the inconvenience.
dialog.need_new: Use /new to create a lecture draft first.
dialog.preparing: Preparation is in progress. Wait for it to finish or use /cancel.
dialog.second_source: This draft already has one recording. Replace the draft, or finish adding materials. Recordings are never merged implicitly.
dialog.source_first: Send the recording or a public link to it first; add materials afterwards.
dialog.youtube_mode: YouTube preparation: video or audio only? Only a single public, non-live YouTube video is supported.
dialog.add_materials: Recording queued for download. You can send additional documents or photos while it downloads. Press Files added when you are done: I will wait for every download and show the summary for your confirmation before starting.
dialog.finish_waiting: Accepted; no more files are expected. I will finish downloading and checking the files already received, then show the summary automatically for your confirmation before starting. Download and preparation continue.
dialog.import_waiting: Files are still downloading or being checked. You can send more materials; Files added will remember your decision and continue preparation after all downloads finish.
dialog.input_ready: The file is ready. Add materials or press Files added to review and confirm the run.
dialog.action_recorded: Your action has already been accepted. Current status: {status}.
dialog.accepted: Job {id} accepted. FIFO position: {position}. A new run consumes quota even if it fails or is cancelled.
dialog.delivery_pending: Result delivery has been queued. Telegram delivery failure will not restart processing.
dialog.cancel_prompt: Cancel this selected set of your unfinished jobs ({count}) and drafts ({drafts})? Quota and already consumed processing resources are not refunded.
dialog.cancel_requested: Cancellation recorded. Running preparation or processing stops and is reaped before another task starts. Completed jobs are not cancelled.
dialog.language: Select the interface language. Notes follow it unless you explicitly override their language.
dialog.number: Enter a finite number for {name}. fps > 0; hash threshold integer 0–64; minimum scene duration ≥ 0; slides DPI positive integer. /settings returns to the menu.
error.quota: Processing quota exhausted. Next slot becomes available at {timestamp} (UTC). Existing-result delivery is still free.
error.model_missing: Selected {category} model “{model}” is no longer available. Choose an available model in Advanced; no replacement was made.
error.invalid_number: Invalid value. Use a finite number within the stated range; integer settings require an integer.
error.draft_incomplete: The recording or some materials have not finished importing. Wait for preparation; then review the summary again.
error.summary_changed: Parameters, files, models or core version changed since this summary. Review and confirm a fresh summary.
error.model_keys_unavailable: The selected model cannot run: required server credentials are unavailable. Contact an administrator or select another model.
error.reuse_unavailable: The existing result is no longer available. Choose a new processing run or cancel; no processing starts automatically.
error.paused: The server is paused. New preparation will resume after an administrator resumes it.
error.execution_busy: Another preparation or job is active. Please wait.
error.stale: This action is no longer available. Reopen /settings or /jobs.
error.unsupported_input: Send a recording, material or public file link (Yandex Disk, Google Drive, direct HTTP(S)); a single YouTube video is also supported. Commands, local paths and private files are not accepted.
admin_pause_notice: Pause saved. No new preparation or jobs will start; current work is allowed to finish.
admin_resume_notice: Pause cleared. Preparation and jobs may continue in the shared FIFO queue.
admin_access_queued: Access for {username} will open on their first message to the bot.
admin_banned_notice: User {target} banned. Unfinished work is being cancelled by administrator; history, quota usage and files are retained.
admin_allow_help: New access: /allow <numeric ID | @username | t.me/username> [label]. A nickname the bot has not seen yet is remembered and granted on the person's first message to the bot.
admin_cost_notice: Estimated API cost (not a provider invoice): known total {known}; incomplete calls {incomplete}. Local API: provider charge 0, electricity not estimated. Cloud CPU/GPU are unavailable; shared server GPU activity is not user-attributed usage.
admin_native_metadata: Native Bot API metadata on SSD
admin_native_notice: Native Bot API is separate opaque storage. Its cache is managed by the native storage optimizer; /purge does not remove live files, TDLib databases, binlogs or transport copies. Own inputs and results are retained until manual purge. Unavailable sizes are shown as unknown.
admin_confirm_ban: Ban user {target} and cancel their unfinished jobs and draft lecture? Quota usage, costs, history and files are retained.
admin_confirm_cancel: Cancel job {target} as administrator? Consumed quota and API charges are not refunded. An active process will be stopped before the next work starts.
admin_confirm_purge: Delete only the own server files of {target}? Deliveries to other users depending on this result: {count}. Their history will show deleted files. History, quota and costs remain; a foreign reuse source and native cache are not deleted.
admin_purged: Own files of {target} deleted. Dependent deliveries to other users: {count}. Metadata, quota usage and costs are retained.
admin_nothing_cancelled: The job is already finished or cancellation is already requested. Its state was not changed.
admin_cancelled: {kind} {target}: cancelled by administrator. Consumed quota and costs are not refunded.
admin_error_cannot_ban_admin: A configured administrator cannot be banned through the bot.
admin_error_work_active: Work is still active. Cancel it first and wait for the process to stop; files were not deleted.
admin_error_invalid_uuid: A full work UUID is required: /job <UUID> or /purge <UUID>.
admin_error_invalid_user_id: A positive numeric Telegram user ID is required here. Example: /ban 123456, /stats 123456. /allow also accepts @username or a t.me/username link.
admin_error_invalid_username: Provide a numeric user ID, @username or a t.me/username link.
admin_error_invalid_arguments: Invalid arguments. Use /admin for the command list.
admin_error_purge_failed: Deletion failed. History is retained; inspect details on the server.
admin_error_safe_purge_unavailable: Safe deletion is unavailable in this environment. Files were not deleted.
admin_error_unavailable: This action is currently unavailable. Refresh the screen and check the work state.
intake.preparing: Recording received; starting download and file checks.
intake.error.unsupported_input: This file is not supported. Send a recording or an allowed material.
intake.error.invalid_file_metadata: The file is damaged or lacks required metadata. Send it again.
intake.error.input_too_large: The file is larger than the allowed size.
intake.error.telegram_file_too_large: Unfortunately, the bot can accept Telegram attachments only up to 20 MB. Attachment metadata was received, but the file cannot be downloaded: this is a limit of the current Telegram Bot API, not Absorbent. We apologize for the inconvenience. Upload the file to the cloud (Yandex Disk or Google Drive) or your own server, enable access without authentication, and send the bot a public file link or a direct HTTP(S) download link. Previously accepted task files are preserved.
intake.error.invalid_url: Send a valid public HTTP(S) link to one file without a username or password.
intake.error.unsafe_url: The link was rejected: its address or redirect violates the security policy.
intake.error.download_failed: Could not download the public file. Check that it is accessible without authentication and send the link again.
intake.error.work_limit: Working files exceeded the allowed size. Processing was stopped.
intake.error.storage_unavailable: Storage is unavailable: the disk is unmounted, full or read-only. Intake is stopped.
intake.error.unsafe_file_path: The file path is unsafe; import rejected.
intake.error.invalid_duration: Could not determine the recording duration: the file is damaged or the length is invalid.
intake.error.media_too_long: The recording is longer than the allowed limit ({max_media_seconds} seconds).
intake.error.missing_audio: The recording has no audio track.
intake.error.invalid_material: The material is damaged or unreadable.
intake.error.material_pages_exceeded: The total number of material pages exceeds the limit ({max_material_pages}).
intake.error.analysis_failed: Could not inspect the file. Try sending it again.
intake.error.invalid_youtube_url: Unsupported YouTube link. A link to a single video, without a playlist or live stream, is required.
intake.error.invalid_youtube_metadata: Could not fetch YouTube video metadata.
intake.error.youtube_live: Live streams and upcoming premieres are not supported.
intake.error.youtube_unavailable: The video is unavailable: it may be private or removed.
intake.error.youtube_failed: Could not download the YouTube video.
intake.error.telegram_file_unavailable: Telegram did not return the file. Send it again or reduce its size.
intake.error.media_exists: This input already has its source media. Replace the recording with a new task.
intake.error.source_first: Send the recording first; add materials after it.
intake.error.sandbox_unavailable: The isolated sandbox is unavailable; processing is stopped.
intake.error.handshake_failed: The isolated sandbox failed to start.
intake.error.invalid_runtime: The installed runtime is not suitable for processing.
intake.error.interrupted: Import interrupted by a server restart.
engine.admin_error: Work {id}: error {code}. Details are retained in its server log.
engine.interrupted: {id}: interrupted by restart. Processing is not automatically repeated; files are retained.
engine.delivery_unavailable: {id}: result unavailable for delivery. Files may have been deleted or access to the original result revoked; processing was not repeated.
engine.failed: {id}: processing failed. Files and history are retained; contact an administrator.
